prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1067; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Claimant reports neck pain and headache and states she was evaluated at an urgent care facility. Police report requested. Claimant is not represented by counsel and has asked for guidance on the claims process.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from claimant. She describes her head striking the headrest on impact and reports ringing in the ears and brief confusion at the scene. She reports ongoing headaches, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating at work. Advised claimant that medical records and a physician's diagnosis will be needed to evaluate the injury. Provided list of required documentation.

Entry 3: Claimant confirmed a diagnosis of concussion from her primary care physician and has begun symptom management. Requested authorization to obtain treatment records. Claimant signed release form and returned it by fax. Noted that claimant has no attorney and has not yet discussed settlement expectations. Explained that the carrier cannot give legal advice and suggested she may wish to consult an attorney if she has questions about her rights.

Entry 4: Photos of both vehicles received from the insured and the third party. Damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact. Vehicle inspection scheduled with appraiser. Claimant called to check status and reported that headaches persist with screen use. Advised her to follow her treating physician's restrictions and to keep a symptom journal.

Entry 5: Neurologist referral noted in medical file. Claimant has not yet returned to full work duties and has provided a note from her physician. Reviewed file with supervisor for reserve adjustment pending receipt of complete medical records. Claimant to be contacted once records are received. Diary set for follow-up in thirty days.
